emergencyContacts.heroDescription: Important contact numbers for emergency assistance, public services and Gram Panchayat officials. Keep these numbers handy when you need help.
emergencyContacts.noticeDescription: In case of an emergency, contact the appropriate emergency service immediately. For immediate assistance anywhere in India, call the national emergency helpline 112.

officialContacts.title: Key Officials Contact
officialContacts.description: Contact the Gram Panchayat officials for village administration, development work and public services.

usefulContacts.title: Emergency and Useful Contacts
usefulContacts.description: Important telephone numbers for emergency services, public utilities, education and child welfare.

emergencyContacts.guidelinesDescription: Follow these steps when contacting an emergency service.

guidelines.1: Stay calm and explain the emergency clearly.
guidelines.2: Provide your exact location and nearby landmarks.
guidelines.3: Share a working contact number so the response team can reach you.
guidelines.4: Follow the instructions given by the emergency service.

emergencyContacts.panchayatNoteDescription: For village-level complaints, public services and administrative assistance, contact the Gram Panchayat office or the concerned official.
